# daroms-speed-site

> A Next.js framework and Claude Code workflow that turns a brief into a varied, production-grade website at low token cost.

## Docs

- [daroms-speed-site](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/index.md): A Next.js framework and Claude Code workflow that turns a brief into a varied, production-grade website at low token cost.
- [Getting started](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/getting-started.md): Create a site with one command, open it in Claude Code, and let the /dss-site skill take it from brief to deploy.
- [For AI agents](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/agents.md): The operating manual for an agent (Claude Code or any coding agent): what to read, how to start a site, the contract every site follows and the checks to run before saying done.
- [Architecture](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/architecture.md): Versioned infrastructure in core packages, owned visual code in the site, data files the CLI rewrites, generated files nobody edits.
- [Design DNA](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/design-dna.md): Each site rolls a deterministic, accessible design identity that avoids the combinations of recent sites and the usual generated-site tells.
- [AI layer](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/ai-layer.md): How dss keeps Claude Code fast and cheap: small always-on context, rules by path, forked workers, guard hooks, a router and a shared brain.
- [Modules and data](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/modules.md): Optional features install site-owned code, environment documentation, CSP sources and manifest entries, and plug into generated slots.
- [Deploy, security and SEO](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/deploy.md): Static by default, secure headers and CSP from the manifest, previews never indexed, one command per target.
- [Visual edits with AimKit](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/aimkit.md): Pick an element in the browser, type the change, and Claude Code opens the exact file and line.
- [Factory: brain, sites, batch, upgrades](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/factory.md): What makes dss a production line: a memory shared by all sites, a registry, batch creation, upgrades and releases.
- [CLI reference](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/cli.md): Every dss command, generated from the CLI itself. In a site run them as `pnpm dss <command>`.

## Catalog

- [Catalog](https://daromsartof.github.io/daroms-speed-site/catalog.md): tokens, components, sections, modules, archetypes, font pairs, package APIs
